conclusion.verdict: WMB not weaker than Karpathy original core contract
conclusion.reason: All 24 core capabilities recalibrated to present/present-plus against WMB-5236..5240 implemented facts, each with runnable test/SQLite/real-Electron evidence; 5 stronger business extensions (fixed-version query, Pi operator protocol, visual source lineage, media bindings, knowledge network) documented separately and not used to mask core gaps.
notes: Karpathy's deck/chart output forms are optional and modular per baseline text; native equivalents are synthesis wiki page (markdown) + canvas + structured index/search read models.

Entity/Method/Map wiki page synthesis is schema-supported (pageType entity/method/map with subject binding) but not auto-produced by ingest; cross-page contract is satisfied via atomic multi-object ChangeSet (topic pages + notes + entities + evidence links + receipts).
Test-side defects repaired during final acceptance (9 items across wmb-5237-source-body-revisions / visual-source-lineage / media-bindings); all now PASS, no product code changes.
